Kelly Rowland stopped by Lovers and Friends podcast with Shan Boodram to discuss Sex, Kink, Divorce and Repressed Desires in her new #1 Netflix film, Mea Culpa. If you'd like to watch the FULL 45 minute interview click here https://youtu.be/Dcp5jUctOMw?si=D9Wjk0WSoCCY4fRn

Kelly Rowland, you read right. This is a CAN NOT MISS, special release Lovers and Friends episode with Shan Boodram AND it is best experienced after you watch Mea Culpa now streaming worldwide on Netflix. In this intimate, first-of-its-kind conversation Kelly Rowland shares how she went from a sexually repressed upbringing to living up to her pleasure potential as a sensualist, plus how her sexual awakening gave her the confidence to play Mea in Mea Clupa alongside Trevante Rhodes, whom she shares very STEAMY sex scenes with on screen. Kelly also discusses her feelings on divorce, kink, toys in the bedroom, and overcoming the fear of being imperfect.
